event_data.context: Post-reinstall live evidence isolated the remaining failure. Both Tiber Tasks and plugin-advisory final review use signed GitEventStore commits, but the installed MCP manifest forwards SSH_AUTH_SOCK only to Tiber. Development Discipline therefore fails at commit-tree -S when launched by Codex, while the exact installed binary succeeds when run directly with the inherited socket. Repair the installed-root MCP launch contract by forwarding SSH_AUTH_SOCK to Development Discipline, preserve mandatory signing, prove the manifest/startup contract and signed advisory lifecycle, release a synchronized patch, then verify live after reinstall. The stashed Tiber spike remains untouched.
event_data.summary: Forward the owner SSH signing agent to Development Discipline so live advisory EventCore appends succeed without weakening signing.
event_data.title: Fix shared review EventCore append failures
